item: Büro Dr. Rösti GmbH (own consultancy, Uetendorf)
detail: Sole owner and managing director of his consultancy, through which he channelled many of his paid mandates. After his election the shares were transferred to his wife and the company was placed into liquidation, as Federal Council members may not hold gainful secondary positions.

item: Energy, fuel and transport lobby mandates (Swissoil, auto-schweiz, AVES, water-management association, Astag advisory board)
detail: Before joining the Federal Council, Roesti held a portfolio of energy- and transport-related mandates, including the presidencies of Swissoil, auto-schweiz, AVES and the Swiss Water Management Association, and an advisory-board seat at the road-transport association Astag. These created a documented overlap with the policy areas he would oversee as head of DETEC. All were relinquished on taking office.
